Prefer a provider different from the candidate author, except GPT-authored candidates may use GPT review to consume Codex subscriptions. A paired cross-reviewer must use a different exact model. Read-only role boundaries and task SPEC remain controlling.

profiles.name: Review Fallback — Grok 4.6
